description: Source code for ImageImporterBmp class and related classes, handling BMP image import and processing within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: ImageImporterBmp
classes.description: Handles importing BMP images from streams, testing headers, and creating image data for PDF.

classes.name: ImportedImageBitmap
classes.description: Represents a bitmap image imported for PDF processing, prepares image data.

classes.name: ImageDataBitmap
classes.description: Holds image data in bitmap format, including pixel data, masks, and palette.

classes.name: ImagePrivateDataBitmap
classes.description: Contains raw bitmap data and methods to copy and process bitmap images.

methods.name: ImportImage
methods.description: Main method to import an image from a stream, testing headers and returning an imported image.

methods.name: TestBitmapFileHeader
methods.description: Checks if the stream starts with a valid BMP header ('BM') and retrieves data offset.

methods.name: TestBitmapInfoHeader
methods.description: Validates the bitmap info header and extracts image properties like size, dimensions, and format.

methods.name: PrepareImage
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to prepare image data for PDF output.

methods.name: CopyBitmap
methods.description: Copies bitmap data into a PDF-compatible format, handling different pixel formats.

methods.name: CopyTrueColorMemoryBitmap
methods.description: Copies true color (RGB/ARGB) bitmap data, handling line flipping and masks.

methods.name: CopyIndexedMemoryBitmap
methods.description: Copies indexed color bitmaps, handling palettes, transparency, and compression.
